description: List small groups / ministries with meeting day, time, place and frequency; add fields=["people"] to include members and leaders. Elvanto: groups/getAll.

category_id.description: Only groups in this group category id (or any of these ids).

fields.description: Optional extra group fields: people (members and their position), categories, departments, demographics, locations.

page_size.description: Records per page, 1-1000. Default 100 here (Elvanto's own default is 1000).

suspended.description: yes = only suspended groups, no = exclude them. Default all.

name: elvanto_list_groups
title: List groups
